title: Capitalization versus Expensing: Evidence on the Uncertainty of Future Earnings from Capital Expenditures versus R&D Outlays
sources_checked: Current local resource catalog: output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json, SHA-256 4fbed8b9668ba690dbce68bcbae08bbe4f3780cf4051a1d3f9fc11c43d336a27 (matches the assigned feasibility record). It names COMP.FUNDA as the current merged annual file, 941,340 rows and 949 columns; no separate compatible 1997-vintage file is listed in this catalog.

COMP.FUNDA: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; current local merged Annual source. Metadata identifies numeric FYEAR and SAS-date DATADATE (YYMMDDN8). Aggregate scan with accepted INDL/STD/C/D filters found all FY1993–2002; FY2002 DATADATE spans 2002-06-30 to 2003-05-31. FY1998–2002 added input had no duplicate GVKEY/FYEAR keys or tied maximum-completeness records. See work/source_coverage.json.

COMP.G_EXRT_MTH: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_mth.sas7bdat; the FY1998–2002 required GBP-intermediary monthly flow-rate pairs are positive and unique after the accepted construction rule; all 120 observed pairs were covered from 1998-06-30 through 2003-05-31. See work/source_coverage.json.

COMP.G_EXRT_DLY, COMP.SEC_MTH, and COMP.SEC_MTHPRC: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_dly.sas7bdat, ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/security/sec_mth.sas7bdat, and ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/security/sec_mthprc.sas7bdat. Their accepted date bound remains 1998-05-31; this supports FY1997 sample prices and t−1 deflators. The same source route and bound were used by the assigned executed attempt_02.

Assigned predecessor: output/reproductions/packages/W11897853/attempt_02/outcome.json and its aggregate Table 3/4 Markdown outputs. Used for cell/table mapping, acceptance state, and original-vintage estimate comparison only; no prior generated data or tables entered the extension run.
changes: Pooled the original annual fit years 1972–1992 with five added fiscal years 1993–1997, preserving the 1972 start, the accepted annual OLS/Fama–MacBeth construction, the model terms, sample screens, fixed data transformations, and Newey–West lag 5. All three primary fits completed for 26 full-rank years.

Rebuilt the full current-vintage input history from FY1968 through FY2002. Shifted only the monthly flow-FX source bound to 2003-05-31, the latest observed FY2002 DATADATE; daily FX and exact-date security/price source bounds remain at 1998-05-31 because the latest sample-year price and t−1 deflator are for FY1997.

Retained numeric FYEAR through SAS-to-Stata handoff and added native diagnostics after each primary xtfmb fit. Counts use that fit’s e(sample) and the 1972–1992 versus 1993–1997 year ranges; last_added is computed from e(sample) and printed as EXT_SAMPLE.
limitations: The paper used 1997 Annual Industrial and Annual Research files; COMP.FUNDA is the current merged annual vintage. The original-window and extended estimates are current-vintage comparisons, not a reconstruction of the authors’ 1997 data release.

Original-window estimator counts in the accepted current-vintage route are lower than paper-reported table sample sizes: 22,951 vs 42,776 for Table 3 Panel A, 21,929 vs 40,569 for Table 3 Panel B, and 14,817 vs 29,408 for Table 4 Panel B. Exact attribution is unresolved; construction/route attrition is visible, but it is not established as a vintage-only cause.
Historic issue/date coverage and positive GBP-to-currency FX legs limit some price and dollar constructions; the build reports route, quote, rate, and future-EPS conversion attrition separately.

The source item-54 prose conflicts with the provider crosswalk (A54 maps to CSHPRI; A25 maps to CSHO); preferred-equity market value for the exact Altman X4 is unavailable, and leverage denominator wording conflicts across equation, data section and table note.

The annual-versus-pooled winsorization order and exact percentile-bin convention are not fully specified. The accepted route uses annual P1/P99 quantile boundaries and records the source wording conflict.

Capitalized-R&D timing within its five-year 20% straight-line life and the share denominator are not fully specified. The accepted route uses weights 1.0 through 0.2 on t through t−4 and divides the current dollar asset by end-period CSHO.
Annual coefficient distributions are summarized in memory from the by-year fits and are exported as aggregate statistics; no annual coefficient dataset is saved.
